## Selected case studies

- [Poliatletas](https://vilquer.dev/projetos/poliatletas/): athletics management, NestJS, Fastify, PostgreSQL, Prisma, React, and Redis.
- [RotinaPet](https://vilquer.dev/projetos/rotinapet/): authorized RAG for shared pet care, Kotlin, Spring Boot, Angular, PostgreSQL, pgvector, and OpenAI.
- [Viazio](https://vilquer.dev/projetos/viazio/): explainable travel ranking with Java 21, Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL, and Resilience4j.

## Applied research

- [TrackShot CV](https://vilquer.dev/projetos/trackshot/): computer vision for shot-put release metrics using smartphone video.
